meta.title: The Best Spring Jacket: The Baracuta G9. (Harrington)
meta.description:
Buy this jacket here! https://amzn.to/3CR3FIo
(adds no cost to you, but I get a little guap)

Read the Stridewise article about this jacket, featuring ME! https://stridewise.com/baracuta-g-9-harrington-jacket-review/

Ah yes, Spring has sprung! So what is one of the most famous Spring time jackets of all time? Well it has to be the Harrington jacket, specifically the Baracuta G9 (there are a few others who claim they also were the first to make it). Also make sure you spell it right! It's not Barracuda. It's Baracuta baby!

So does this rival the likes of Barbour? In purpose no, but in fame and classic jackets? Oh yes! This is one of the essential jackets that everyone needs.

TAH TAH!
